title: DC DUEL
oneLiner: Battle iconic DC heroes in fast, readable one-on-one super fights.
mechanics: The player selects Batman, Superman, or Flash, then fights computer-controlled DC opponents in best-of-three rounds; each round begins with both fighters controllable immediately and a brief harmless spacing period.

Left/right move horizontally and change facing; Up jumps; Down crouches. Fighters can block while holding B, reducing damage and preventing most knockback, but throws and low attacks beat standing block.

A performs the character's quick attack: Batman close punch, Superman straight punch, or Flash fast kick. It has 4-frame startup, 4-frame active time, and 8-frame recovery; each attack can hit a target only once.

B performs the character's special only when not blocking and with at least 25 energy: Batman throws a slow batarang, Superman fires a short heat burst, or Flash performs a horizontal lightning dash. Specials have clear startup and recovery and consume 25 energy.

A successful normal hit deals 6 damage and causes 10 frames of hitstun; a special deals 10 damage and causes stronger knockback. The attacker gains a small combo bonus for landing another hit within 90 frames, capped at 3 hits.

Opponents alternate between approach, attack, block, retreat, and recovery states. They telegraph attacks with a 12-frame pose, never attack more often than once per 45 frames, and remain punishable for 18 frames after a blocked or missed heavy action.

Health starts at 100 and slowly refills by 1 point per second only during a 2-second no-hit recovery window; energy starts at 50 and regenerates by 1 per second, capped at 100. A round ends at zero health or when the 60-second timer expires, with higher health winning.

Win two rounds to clear a match and advance through four opponents with bounded difficulty: later opponents gain modest reaction speed and health, but enemy damage, simultaneous projectiles, and movement speed each have fixed caps.

Earn 100 points for a normal hit, 250 for a special hit, 500 for a three-hit combo, and 1,000 for winning a round. Display hit sparks, hit sounds, knockback, health changes, and a brief KO flash; reset health, energy, combo, and positions at every round.
After the final opponent, show a victory pose and score; losing all three rounds shows a defeat screen, and A returns to the character-select screen.
artDirection: 256x224 arcade fighting screen with two 48–58 pixel-tall fighters, large readable silhouettes, and a simple Gotham rooftop arena. Batman uses a black-and-dark-gray cowl silhouette, pointed ears, blue-gray highlights, yellow belt, and a flowing cape; Superman uses blue suit blocks, red cape and boots, and a bright chest emblem; Flash uses a red silhouette, yellow lightning ear wings and yellow accents. Use distinct idle, walk, crouch, jump, punch, kick, block, hitstun and knockout poses. Keep the floor and skyline dark and low-detail, with bright impact stars and character colors separated from the background. Include three selectable fighters, each with a distinct special move: Batman batarang, Superman heat burst, Flash lightning dash.

controls.left: Move left; also choose a fighter in character select.
controls.right: Move right; also choose a fighter in character select.
controls.up: Jump during a round; move selection upward in character select if applicable.
controls.down: Crouch during a round; move selection downward in character select if applicable.
controls.a: Quick attack during active play; confirm fighter selection and advance after results.
controls.b: Hold to block while grounded or crouching; tap to use the fighter's special when not blocking and energy is at least 25; cancel menus if applicable.

lose: Lose the match by losing two rounds, or let the 60-second round timer expire with less health than the opponent.
scoring: Score for unique hits, three-hit combos, special attacks, and round wins; combo bonuses expire after 90 frames and reset on being hit or at round end.
